method: Direct inspection of all eleven side-by-side images, six-face corpus sheet, wide signed money and long input start/end captures. Each comparison uses two 960x540 panes with proportional containment; explicit crops are recorded.

observations.families: Roboto for body/major titles and Roboto Condensed for compact labels/actions preserve the accepted hierarchy with real face weights. The concepts use drawn letterforms; exact identity is not asserted.
observations.apparent_size: Production captions and table cells are smaller than the concept where the real catalog, financial columns and explanatory text are denser. Per-consumer sizes remain explicit; no global font shrink or text scaling was introduced in FONT-10.
observations.spacing: Native line height is retained. Dense catalogs/reports use native scroll; input clipping is accompanied by actual horizontal caret scrolling.
observations.results: Monthly and quarterly comparisons use populated, persisted campaigns rather than empty placeholders.
observations.wide_values: Signed seven-digit values fit the KPI and financial views in the five viewports. Descenders and accents remain visible at both ends of the long input.
observations.remaining_composition_differences: Existing artwork, step count, capitalization, catalog entries, economic values and content density differ from the concepts. These were preserved from the accepted working baseline.
